_comment: The Glam Shelf — the default brand (used when BRAND_CONFIG_PATH is unset). Every value here is what Twin had hard-coded before multi-brand settings; tests/test_brand_golden.py fails if one drifts. Field guide: docs/CLIENT_SETUP.md.
